samples.summary: Cross-tab undo jump is not wired into the shared-document surface, where undo is NOT always disabled
samples.evidence: `sheet-view.tsx` documents `onUndoJump` as "omitted (the read-only share view) simply means no cross-tab undo, which is moot there since undo is disabled". But `shared-document.tsx:198` computes `const readOnly = resolved.role === "viewer"`, so an *editor*-role share link renders `<SheetView tabId={activeTabId} readOnly={false} peerJumpTarget={peerJumpTarget} />` (line 300) with no `undoJumpTarget`/`onUndoJump`. That surface has its own tab bar (lines 304-306), so an editor who edits Sheet2, switches to Sheet1 and presses undo gets exactly the reported defect the task targets — the CRDT changes, nothing visible moves, no tab switch. Acceptance criterion 3 of docs/tasks/active/20260917-sheets-undo-selection-todo.md ("A change in another sheet switches to that sheet before selecting") is therefore unmet on that surface, and the justifying comment in the diff is factually wrong.
searchedFor: Grep '<SheetView' across packages/frontend/src/**/*.tsx (only document-detail.tsx and shared-document.tsx)

samples.summary: Two independent implementations of "apply an UndoSelection" (Sheet.applyUndoSelection vs Spreadsheet.focusUndoSelection) that can diverge
samples.evidence: `Sheet.applyUndoSelection` builds the selection by hand (`this.selectionType = …`, `this.activeCell = normalizeRefToAnchor(start)`, `ranges = [expandRangeToMergedBoundaries(...)]`, row/column spans from `this.dimension`), while the cross-tab path `Spreadsheet.focusUndoSelection` re-derives the same semantics through `selectRow`/`selectRowRange`/`selectColumn`/`selectColumnRange`/`selectStart`/`selectEnd`. The same `UndoSelection` can therefore be applied two different ways depending on whether the step landed in the open tab, and any future fix to one (e.g. the merge-invariant fix recorded in the task doc) has to be remembered in the other. A single `Sheet`-level entry point reused by both would avoid the divergence.

samples.summary: Yorkie CRDT operation-path parsing placed inside the collaboration-agnostic @wafflebase/sheets package
samples.evidence: `undo-selection.ts` hardcodes the Yorkie document-path grammar (`const SheetPathPrefix = '$.sheets.'`, `parseSheetPath`, `cells.<key>` vs `cells` + key forms) in packages/sheets/src/model/workbook. docs/design/sheets/collaboration.md:27 lists "Keep the shared `@wafflebase/sheets` package collaboration-agnostic where possible" as a goal, and the repo's existing precedent for parsing exactly these paths lives in the adapter layer (packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/remote-change-utils.ts). The module's own doc comment concedes it is modelling the collaboration layer's shape structurally to avoid importing the SDK; the resolver could take an already-decoded, transport-neutral touch list from `YorkieStore` instead. No behavioral consequence today.

samples.summary: Header-selection rule (spec item 4) is not met for inserts/deletes at the end of the axis
samples.evidence: `diffAxisSpan` deliberately returns `undefined` for any diff confined to the tail, so undoing a delete of the LAST row/column (or an append-insert) falls through to the cell branch and restores a cell-range selection instead of the row/column header selection required by acceptance item 4 of the task doc. The task doc records this under "Known limitations" (lines 217-220), but the design doc section added to docs/design/sheets/sheet.md does not mention the exception — nor the unhandled `conditionalFormats` / `dataValidations` ranges — so the documented rule reads as unconditional.
searchedFor: read docs/design/sheets/sheet.md new 'Selection after undo / redo' section

samples.summary: Task doc claims MemStore/ReadOnlyStore signature updates landed; both still declare the old return type
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260917-sheets-undo-selection-todo.md:110 ticks "`MemStore` / `ReadOnlyStore` signature updates", but memory.ts:683/687 and readonly.ts:327/331 still declare `Promise<{ success: boolean }>` rather than `Promise<UndoResult>`. Structurally assignable, so nothing breaks; only the task record and the interface's stated shape are out of step.

finding.summary: Cross-tab undo jump is not wired into the shared-document surface, where undo is NOT always disabled
finding.evidence: `sheet-view.tsx` documents `onUndoJump` as "omitted (the read-only share view) simply means no cross-tab undo, which is moot there since undo is disabled". But `shared-document.tsx:198` computes `const readOnly = resolved.role === "viewer"`, so an *editor*-role share link renders `<SheetView tabId={activeTabId} readOnly={false} peerJumpTarget={peerJumpTarget} />` (line 300) with no `undoJumpTarget`/`onUndoJump`. That surface has its own tab bar (lines 304-306), so an editor who edits Sheet2, switches to Sheet1 and presses undo gets exactly the reported defect the task targets — the CRDT changes, nothing visible moves, no tab switch. Acceptance criterion 3 of docs/tasks/active/20260917-sheets-undo-selection-todo.md ("A change in another sheet switches to that sheet before selecting") is therefore unmet on that surface, and the justifying comment in the diff is factually wrong.
searchedFor: Grep '<SheetView' across packages/frontend/src/**/*.tsx (only document-detail.tsx and shared-document.tsx)

verdict.reason: The absence is real and I could not find any counterexample. shared-document.tsx:300 mounts SheetView with peerJumpTarget but no undoJumpTarget/onUndoJump, and a repo-wide grep shows document-detail.tsx:762-763 is the only host that wires them. The surface is not read-only for editor-role links (shared-document.tsx:198 sets readOnly only for role "viewer"), and undo is gated solely on the engine's readOnly flag (worksheet.ts:5105-5108) with YorkieStore.undo fully functional (yorkie-store.ts:1276-1284), so an editor share-link user with multiple tabs hits exactly the defect the task targets: the CRDT changes, no tab switch, no selection move. sheet-view.tsx:1082-1084 has no fallback when onUndoJump is omitted, and the prop comment at sheet-view.tsx:162-168 justifying the omission ("the read-only share view ... undo is disabled") is factually wrong for editor-role shares. Acceptance criterion 3 of the task doc (line 40) is therefore unmet on that surface — a user-visible unmet outcome, hence blocking under the design-fit rubric's major bar. (The task's own task list line 114 names only DocumentLayout, which is the only mitigating reading, but that is scope framing, not a counterexample.)
